meta.scope: Uruguay batch 4 — Dairy sector depth, soybeans, tax administration, public debt, and remaining high-value fiscal/social nodes. Final expansion pass.

candidates.title: Lácteos — producción y exportaciones
candidates.description: Statistics of dairy production and exports (whole milk powder, cheese, butter, etc.). Major traditional agro-industrial export and a significant rural employer.
candidates.notes: Signature agro-export. 2025 export billing ~USD 965 mn (record/near-record). Whole milk powder dominates; Algeria and Brazil are leading destinations. Completes the agro-export triad with beef and cellulose.

candidates.title: Instituto Nacional de la Leche (INALE)
candidates.description: Sector institute that compiles and disseminates primary and commercial statistics for the dairy chain. Key analytical and policy-support body for the sector.
candidates.notes: Primary statistical and analytical node for the dairy chain. Continuously cited in production, price and export analysis.

candidates.title: Soja y granos — producción y exportaciones
candidates.description: Statistics of soybean and other grain production and exports. Major component of the agricultural export basket alongside beef, cellulose and dairy.
candidates.notes: Important traditional export line. Frequently ranks among the top merchandise exports by value.

candidates.title: Dirección General Impositiva (DGI) — tax collection
candidates.description: National tax administration. Publishes tax collection by type of tax and performance against annual targets.
candidates.notes: Primary revenue-side fiscal statistic. Links the real-side economy to the central-government budget.

candidates.title: Deuda pública / Public debt statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas / BCU
candidates.description: Stock and flow statistics of central-government and public-sector debt (external and domestic). Key sustainability indicator.
candidates.notes: Critical fiscal-sustainability node. Continuously monitored in macroeconomic and policy analysis.

candidates.title: Departamento de Maldonado — low-poverty southern contrast
candidates.description: Southern coastal department with among the lowest poverty incidence. Completes the low-poverty southern set alongside Colonia.
candidates.notes: Low-poverty southern department; hosts important tourism and residential activity.

candidates.title: Departamento de Canelones — core metropolitan periphery
candidates.description: Large department surrounding Montevideo. Intermediate poverty and inequality; important demographic and economic weight in the greater capital region.
candidates.notes: Completes the greater Montevideo statistical geography. Frequently cited in both poverty and inequality departmental rankings.

candidates.title: Coeficiente de Gini / Income inequality
candidates.description: Official Gini coefficient of income inequality, calculated from ECH income data. Published nationally and by department.
candidates.notes: Companion inequality indicator to the poverty series. 2025 national Gini ~0.40. Montevideo, Salto and Canelones among the highest departmental inequality.

candidates.title: Indicadores de empleo y desempleo (ECH)
candidates.description: Labour-force indicators from the ECH: employment rate, unemployment rate, activity rate, and related quality-of-employment measures.
candidates.notes: Primary high-frequency labour indicators. Derived from the same continuous household survey that underpins the poverty series.

candidates.title: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas — institutional fiscal identity
candidates.description: Central finance ministry responsible for the national budget, public debt, tax policy coordination and macroeconomic fiscal reporting.
candidates.notes: Institutional parent for the fiscal side. Continuously cited as the producer of budget, debt and fiscal-policy analysis.

proposed_edges.basis: Dairy products are a major traditional agro-export line.
Dairy is a core component of the agricultural and agro-industrial sector.
Soybeans and grains are major agricultural export lines.
Tax collection is the primary revenue source of the national budget.
Public debt statistics are compiled and disseminated under the MEF framework.
The Gini coefficient is computed from the same income distribution underlying the poverty estimates.
Employment and unemployment indicators are core products of the ECH.
Canelones forms the principal demographic and economic periphery of the greater Montevideo region.
